commands.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d) || exit 1; mkdir -p "$d/ws" "$d/cfg"; python3 - "$d" <<'PY'
import json, pathlib, subprocess, sys
scratch = sys.argv[1]
env = {"HEADROOM_WORKSPACE_DIR": scratch + "/ws", "HEADROOM_CONFIG_DIR": scratch + "/cfg",
       "HEADROOM_OFFLINE": "1", "DO_NOT_TRACK": "1", "HF_HUB_OFFLINE": "1", "TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE": "1"}

def call(tool, args):
    argv = ["mcporter", "call", "--stdio", "headroom",
            "--stdio-arg", "mcp", "--stdio-arg", "serve", "--stdio-arg", "--proxy-url",
            "--stdio-arg", "http://127.0.0.1:1"]
    for k, v in env.items():
        argv += ["--env", f"{k}={v}"]
    argv += ["--name", "headroom-native-ci", "--tool", tool, "--args", json.dumps(args),
             "--output", "json", "--no-oauth", "--timeout", "20000"]
    out = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30)
    return json.loads(out.stdout, strict=False), out.returncode

records = open("fixtures/headroom-records.json").read()
note = open("fixtures/headroom-note.txt").read()

compressed, rc1 = call("headroom_compress", {"content": records})
print("compress fixtures/headroom-records.json: tokens_saved", compressed.get("tokens_saved"),
      "savings_percent", compressed.get("savings_percent"), "hash", compressed.get("hash"))
retrieved, rc2 = call("headroom_retrieve", {"hash": compressed.get("hash")})
print("retrieve exact match with the original fixture:", retrieved.get("original_content") == records)
short, rc3 = call("headroom_compress", {"content": note})
print("short fixtures/headroom-note.txt stored unchanged:", short.get("compressed") == note,
      "tokens_saved:", short.get("tokens_saved"), "has hash:", bool(short.get("hash")))
negative, rc4 = call("headroom_retrieve", {"hash": "0" * 24})
print("bogus hash reports an error:", "error" in negative)
store = sorted(p.name for p in pathlib.Path(scratch, "ws").rglob("*") if p.is_file())
print("compression store created inside the scratch workspace, not this host's real ~/.headroom:", store)
ok = (rc1 == 0 and rc2 == 0 and rc3 == 0 and rc4 == 0 and retrieved.get("original_content") == records
      and short.get("compressed") == note and short.get("tokens_saved") == 0 and short.get("hash")
      and "error" in negative and compressed.get("tokens_saved", 0) > 0
      and any("ccr_store" in f for f in store))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
PY
rc=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $rc
